facts.source_fact: The annual emissions report covers reportable emissions in the previous scheme year and must comply with the MRR.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve report period and MRR basis.

facts.source_fact: An HSE can submit the report with a declaration instead of using an independent verifier.
The declaration states that the MRR was followed in preparing the report.
The declaration states that the approved monitoring plan was complied with.
The declaration states that the report is free from material misstatements.
If a declaration is used instead of a verification report, the regulator audits the emissions report.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve audit consequence of declaration route.

facts.source_fact: If an independent verifier is used, the annual emissions report must be verified as satisfactory.
The METS task to compile the annual report appears on 1 January following the scheme year.
A verified report amended before regulator submission must be re-submitted to the independent verifier.
If no verified report or declaration-supported report is submitted by 31 March, the regulator determines emissions, may recover costs, and a civil penalty may apply.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve determination, cost and possible-penalty consequences.
